D: A dim male model is brainwashed into becoming an assassin by a fashion mogul.
P: Serve the drinks when the boys order orange mocha iced coffees.
S: Cucumber, celery, carrot and radish sticks with a blue cheese sour cream dip
Cucumber, celery, carrot and radish cut long and lean, stood up in a glass on ice, with a dip of blue cheese mashed into sour cream with lemon, Worcestershire and black pepper.
Cucumber rounds with whipped goat cheese, smoked salmon and dill
Thick cucumber rounds topped with goat's cheese whipped with lemon zest, a curl of smoked salmon and a dill frond, kept very cold.
Coal miner's corned beef rye sandwiches
Derek's family back home in the mines

Corned silverside simmered tender and sliced thin on buttered rye with hot English mustard, Swiss cheese and dill pickles, wrapped in paper like a miner's lunch. Rinse a 1.5kg corned silverside and simmer in a pot of water with a brown onion, 6 cloves, 2 bay leaves and 2 tbsp brown sugar for 3 hours. Cool in the liquid, then slice thin. Butter 8 slices rye bread, spread 4 with English mustard and layer with the beef, 4 slices Swiss cheese and sliced dill pickles. Close, cut in half and wrap each in baking paper.
M: Rigatoni in a creamy vodka tomato sauce with chili and parmesan
Rigatoni cooked 2 minutes short, finished in a sauce of garlic and chilli sautéed in butter, tomato paste fried until brick red, a splash of vodka and cream, parmesan and basil.

Lamb cutlets marinated in lemon, garlic and oregano, grilled hot and pink, with a Greek salad of feta, tomato, cucumber and olives, and warm pita. Mix the juice and zest of a lemon, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 2 tsp dried oregano and 3 tbsp olive oil. Marinate 12 lamb cutlets for 1 hour. Grill on very high heat for 2 minutes a side and rest 3 minutes. Toss 3 chopped tomatoes, a cucumber, half a red onion and 100g kalamata olives with olive oil and red wine vinegar, and top with 150g feta. Warm 4 pita breads on the grill.
W: Vanilla cake with a tiny teacup cake beside it, covered in buttercream
Vanilla sponges baked at 175C, one in a normal tin and one in a teacup, both covered in white buttercream, so there's a cake for ants and a real one for you.
K: Espresso melted with dark chocolate and orange zest, shaken with milk over ice
Double espresso shaken hard with chocolate syrup, orange zest, cold milk and ice, strained into a tall glass over more ice.

s.note: Cucumber, celery, carrot and radish sticks with a blue cheese sour cream dip
s.how: Cut a cucumber, 3 celery sticks, 2 carrots and radishes into long lean sticks and stand them in a glass on ice. Mash 100g blue cheese into 200g sour cream with lemon, Worcestershire and black pepper.

s.note: Cucumber rounds with whipped goat cheese, smoked salmon and dill
s.how: Cut 2 cucumbers into thick rounds. Whip 150g goat's cheese with lemon zest and pipe on top. Add a curl of smoked salmon from 100g and a dill frond. Keep very cold.

m.note: Rigatoni in a creamy vodka tomato sauce with chili and parmesan
m.how: Sauté 2 garlic cloves and chilli in 40g butter. Fry 4 tbsp tomato paste until brick red, add 60ml vodka and cook off, then 250ml cream. Toss with 500g rigatoni cooked 2 minutes short, 50g parmesan and basil.

w.note: Vanilla cake with a tiny teacup cake beside it, covered in buttercream
w.how: Beat 200g butter and 200g sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 250g self-raising flour and 100ml milk. Bake most in a tin and a little in a teacup at 175C, about 30 and 15 minutes. Cover both in 200g butter beaten with 350g icing sugar.

d.note: Espresso melted with dark chocolate and orange zest, shaken with milk over ice
d.how: Brew 4 double espressos with 72g coffee. Melt 60g dark chocolate into the hot coffee with orange zest. Shake with 400ml cold milk and ice, then strain over more ice in four tall glasses.
